tower_targets: All forward nn.Linear weights, including MHA out_proj; each MHA fused in_proj_weight. No conv/norm/bias/positional/reconstruction-head updates.
selection_policy: Fixed100steps; full support/query curves; no query-based selection/scheduler/early stopping. Compare paired user means and negative transfers; stratify shared-training exposure.
sampling_policy: Reuse historical100 support/query IDs. Nested class-balanced24/48 subsets from the100 pool; keep query fixed. Same step/batch/option RNG across arms. Equal optimizer updates, not equal epochs.
limitations: Single seed; each person is an independent reset, not shared user training.
A01-A05 and Nakanishi queries belong to the historical shared training pool; not unseen-data generalization.
SEED subjects seen in shared train, query source trials excluded from shared train.
Historical valid users explicitly reused for requested personal experiments; no new valid memberships or users added.
SEED/HMC sample counts are windows/epochs, not independent trials/nights.
Fixed100steps gives different repeated exposure per sample for different support sizes; do not infer universal optimal trial count.
